# Vacuum control (`vacuum-control`)

A robot cleaner: status, battery, start, pause, return to dock, and the rooms to clean.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createVacuumControl` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/vacuumControl.d.ts`): `.mh-vacuum-control` (on a `.mh-control-card` frame): the state line with `__battery` (icon and percent; `.is-low` below 20%, `.is-charging`) in the trailing slot, an `__error` note, `__actions` (start or resume, pause, dock) and `__rooms`, a chip group choosing where the next run cleans. Modifier `--<state>`, `.is-busy` while moving.

```ts
export function createVacuumControl(options: VacuumControlOptions): VacuumControlHandle;

export interface VacuumControlOptions {
  /** The cleaner's name; also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  state: VacuumState;
  /** Battery level, 0 to 100. */
  battery?: number | null;
  charging?: boolean;
  /** A line after the state ("Kitchen · 14 min"). */
  detail?: string;
  /** What is wrong, shown in a danger note while `state` is `error` ("Brush stuck"). */
  error?: string;
  /** Rooms that can be chosen for the next run. */
  rooms?: readonly VacuumRoom[];
  /** The chosen rooms (ids); kept by the control between updates once the user changes them. */
  selectedRooms?: readonly string[];
  labels?: Partial<VacuumControlLabels>;
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Start (with the chosen rooms; empty for everywhere) or resume. */
  onStart?: (rooms: string[]) => void;
  onPause?: () => void;
  onDock?: () => void;
  onRoomsChange?: (rooms: string[]) => void;
}

export interface VacuumControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<VacuumControlOptions>): void;
}

/** Every visible or spoken word, for translation. */
export interface VacuumControlLabels {
  states: Record<VacuumState, string>;
  /** Start with no rooms chosen. */
  start: string;
  /** Start with rooms chosen: "Clean 2 rooms". */
  startRooms(count: number): string;
  resume: string;
  pause: string;
  dock: string;
  rooms: string;
  battery: string;
  charging: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createVacuumControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const vacuum = createVacuumControl({
  name: 'Floor cleaner',
  state: 'docked',
  battery: 96,
  charging: true,
  rooms: [
    { id: 'living', name: 'Living room' },
    { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen' },
    { id: 'hall', name: 'Hall' },
  ],
  // An empty list means everywhere.
  onStart: (rooms) => {
    const detail = rooms.length ? `${rooms.length} rooms` : 'Everywhere';
    vacuum.update({ state: 'cleaning', charging: false, detail });
  },
  onPause: () => vacuum.update({ state: 'paused' }),
  onDock: () => vacuum.update({ state: 'returning', detail: undefined }),
});

document.body.append(vacuum.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { VacuumControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { VacuumState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = [
  { id: 'living', name: 'Living room' },
  { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen' },
  { id: 'hall', name: 'Hall' },
];

export function VacuumControlExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<VacuumState>('docked');
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>([]);
  return (
    <VacuumControl
      name="Floor cleaner"
      state={state}
      battery={96}
      charging={state === 'docked'}
      rooms={rooms}
      selectedRooms={chosen}
      onRoomsChange={setChosen}
      onStart={() => setState('cleaning')}
      onPause={() => setState('paused')}
      onDock={() => setState('returning')}
    />
  );
}
```
